programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
programme.desc: A shocking look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989 causing a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead.

programme.title: The Accident Files
programme.desc: A look at how spatially disoriented pilots cause crashes.

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
programme.desc: First Air Flight 6560 slammed into a hillside near Resolute Bay, one of the most remote airports in the world.

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
programme.desc: Experts face a tricky investigation into the crash of TANS Peru Flight 204 after key evidence is looted from the crash site.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: She-Wolf of London
programme.desc: Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard (Lon Chaney) makes Southern belle (Louise Allbritton) his bride.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A patient gets drunk to save his life; a patient is stiff after a fall; a patient tasered by the police; a boy impaled by a bottle rocket in the neck.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman risks losing her finger after trying on an engagement ring, a body builder can't breathe and more.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman's face-lift goes wrong, a hospital chaplain's sudden personality change baffles the ER staff and more.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man's head is impaled by a trophy deer's antlers, a nurse's ex brings his new girlfriend to the ER and more.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man has a sword impaled in his head in a roleplaying battle, a patient is terrified of germs and more.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A doctor treats three gunshot victims who claim be innocent bystanders; a doctor must perform emergency brain surgery on his first day; a bride-to-be suddenly slips into a diabetic coma.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman stops eating as she believes she is dead, a runner goes blind in one eye during a marathon and more.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman who inhaled toxic fumes now believes her neighbors want to kill her. A man is near death after an arrow pierces his chest and severs the wires to his pacemaker. Two women with swollen abdomens demand pain relief.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A circus sword swallower suffers from a persistent case of hiccups. A mother and daughter mysteriously collapse in the ER for completely different reasons. A woman loses control of her legs at her daughter's graduation.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: An ER doctor's friend arrives at the hospital combative and out of control, attacking the doctor and others in the ER. A cyclist's throat is torn open when a driver opens a car door in her path. A nursing student is found passed out.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young girl, recently hit by a hockey puck, is now mysteriously paralyzed from the waist down. A young man complains of a splitting headache, but his motives seem suspicious. A bride-to-be has appendicitis.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Doctors use a robot operated by a specialist at another hospital to treat a seizing 7-year-old boy. A chef's tongue is swelling. A woman who crashed her car insists her injured dog be treated first.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A surgeon requires urgent treatment after falling off a bed while trying to help his patient. A man with a slashed wrist has a secret. A woman gives birth to an intact amniotic sac, bewildering her doctor, and then announces she's having twins.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young boy at a sleepover party mysteriously loses control of his arms and legs. A woman is shot in the leg at her own bachelorette party. Air bubbles in a woman's arteries are causing a stroke.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A knifing victim suddenly starts seizing and his doctors can't treat him until they figure out the cause.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young woman in labor begs the ER doctor to keep her pregnancy and delivery a secret from her father.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man is impaled in the abdomen by a stiletto heel. A seemingly healthy outdoorsman has a series of seizures, baffling his doctors. Two patients make their doctor suspicious when they both complain about identical headaches.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Three patients sneak their pets into the hospital, causing pandemonium in the ER. A man experiences paralysis that rises from his legs to his lungs, gradually suffocating him. A war veteran suffers from phantom pain in his amputated hand.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A patient appears to be hallucinating and sends the ER staff on a wild-goose chase around the hospital.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A surfer is impaled between the legs by the fin of his surfboard. A high school football player has flesh-eating disease. A woman is given a powerful clot-busting drug to cure her stroke, but doctors discover she has another condition.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A live boa constrictor wrapped around a man's arm is biting his wrist and won't let go. A young woman has a sliced arm and doctors suspect she may be a victim of human trafficking. A young man with a peanut allergy goes into anaphylactic shock.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: An urgent care physician must invent creative ways to save a choking child and a man whose hand is covered in tar. A woman's pregnancy is a happy surprise, but complications threaten to overshadow the joyful news.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman's pregnancy is a shock to her husband and veers toward tragedy as eclampsia threatens both her life and their child's. A patient is brought to the ER with a live shark clamped onto his thigh - and he wants to save the shark!

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A violent patient faking a coma holds doctors and police hostage after stealing a policeman's gun. An ER doctor on her day off tries to save her cousin from a heart attack, but the cousin's boyfriend keeps getting in the way.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A fishing lure embedded in a man's face turns out to be the least of his problems. A pair of unconscious teenaged mud boggers are brought to the ER where dramatic family secrets are revealed during resuscitation. An ER tech collapses.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man itching from poison oak exposure turns out to also have maggots burrowing into an injury on his back. A young woman has a bleeding lip, but doctors can't find the source of the bleed. Three car accident victims are admitted to the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Two car crash victims, a man and a woman, arrive separately and nearly naked. A boy suffering from nausea is found to have heart block that requires a pacemaker. A woman is so delusional that she throws syringes at the ER staff.

programme.desc: When Andy and Chloe respond to a routine 911 call, they are blindsided by an unseen shooter out for revenge.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: A Walk to Remember
programme.desc: Set in North Carolina, "A Walk To Remember" follows the rite of passage of a jaded, aimless high school senior (Shane West) who falls in love with a guileless young woman (Mandy Moore) he and his friends once scorned. The two develop a powerful and inspirational relationship in which they discover truths that take most people a lifetime to learn.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programme.desc: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

programme.title: The TV Set
programme.desc: Mike Klein (David Duchovny), the creator of a TV pilot called "The Wexler Chronicles," learns the hard way about how television shows evolve from concept to reality. Though Mike's concept involves serious subject, a network executive (Sigourney Weaver) and her cohorts have other plans to lighten up and dumb down the show to appeal to a broader audience.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: David Kepesh (Ben Kingsley), a renowned professor, has no interest in monogamy. Instead, he prefers to dabble in lustful flings with women. When he meets Consuela Castillo (Penélope Cruz), a student in her 20s, he is intensely attracted to her. Though his trusted friend George (Dennis Hopper) warns him not to become overly attached to the much younger Consuela, David begins to feel that his relationship with the student may become serious. However, his personal reservations may doom the affair.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions
programme.desc: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

programme.title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
programme.desc: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
programme.desc: Having failed a secret mission for the Red Flower Society, Chinese folk hero Fong Sai Yuk (Jet Li) must try to get his hands on a special document by wooing the governor's daughter, Man-Yin (Amy Kwok). This doesn't sit well with his fiancée, Ting Ting (Michelle Reis), or with his martial arts-master mother (Josephine Hsiao). Fong enters a martial arts competition, where he faces off against the villainous Yu (Chuen-Hua Chi) as he battles to restore the Ming Dynasty.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

programme.title: Cobra Verde
programme.desc: Francisco Manoel da Silva (Klaus Kinski) plays an enterprising young Brazilian who, after impregnating the three daughters of his plantation-owning employer, is sent to West Africa to round up slaves. Francisco goes to great lengths to befriend the very people he hopes to enslave -- eventually managing to overthrow a mad monarch and set himself up as king.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: In late-1970s suburban London, Chris (Christian Bale) and Marion (Emily Watson) have settled into a comfortable yet all-too-predictable middle-class existence. Chris receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited friend Toni (Lee Ross), a reunion that reminds him of a more carefree time in the 1960s Paris. Now, with lingering doubts about his marriage bubbling up, Chris must make the choice between revisiting his youthful abandon with Toni or facing the here and now with Marion.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: June is a wannabe influencer who's juggling multiple problems: her parents want her to move out, her ex-boyfriend accuses her of stalking him, and two detectives think she may be involved in the robbery of a local pharmacy.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Tiffany (Jamie Foxx), Charlie (Gabriel Byrne) and Vernon (Thandie Newton) are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens (Dina Merrill), a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings (Stuart Townsend) to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Mob assassin Jeffrey (Chow Yun-Fat) is no ordinary hired gun; the best in his business, he views his chosen profession as a calling rather than simply a job. So, when beautiful nightclub chanteuse Jennie (Sally Yeh) is blinded in the crossfire of his most recent hit, Jeffrey chooses to retire after one last job to pay for his unintended victim's sight-restoring operation. But when Jeffrey is double-crossed, he reluctantly joins forces with a rogue policeman (Danny Lee) to make things right.

programme.title: Villains
programme.desc: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

programme.desc: The ticking of her biological clock brings Emon, a hard-driving executive in line for a big promotion, to a decision not shared by her amiable husband Idreese in this intimate drama. A guilty secret buried in her past and an unspoken trauma lurking in his bring on a crisis, as the future of their seemingly perfect marriage hangs in the balance.

programme.title: All The Man I Need
programme.desc: All The Man I Need is about a 39 year old Financial Planner and Investment Strategist named Erica, who has a successful career in finding the right investments for her clients, but has been unsuccessful in finding love and the "right man" for herself.

programme.title: Love and Deceit
programme.desc: A young woman thought she married the perfect man but soon finds out that he is not who she thought he was... Things are not always what they seem.

programme.title: Scam City
programme.desc: In New York City, where the hustlers never sleep, comes a new world and new money. The new trap stars in the hood are the scammers living a life of luxury with their new money, expensive cars and pretty women. But they say money is the root of all evil, and some OG drug dealers from Bed-Stuy ain't liking how it's going down. They have become envious of the young scammers, and now the war is on for the money and the fame, and scamming is now the name of the game... or is it? Welcome to Scam City.

programme.title: Knee Deep The
programme.desc: Gotti, a rising kingpin in Dallas , looks to restructure his organization by adding women to his leadership
programme.sub-title: Knee Deep The Series: Gotti's World

programme.title: The Next Day
programme.desc: Will and Desire' meet at a bar and have a one night stand, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy. Shortly after, Desire' sees Will's cousin Ike shoot someone and becomes a witness in the investigation. Five years later after Ike has left town, and Will's name has been cleared, Desire reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Forbidden Fruit: 2nd Bite
programme.desc: The taste of forbidden fruit is strong, and if the players aren't careful, they may be swallowed whole.

programme.title: For the Gram
programme.desc: Fired from her corporate job, Brandi moves to live with her cousin, who works as an internet model. Brandi follows in her footsteps and becomes successful overnight. Brandi craves the attention from social media and the lifestyle it affords her, but begins to lose sight of who she is. One decision could change your life for better or for worse.

programme.title: Promise Chronicles: Manifestation
programme.desc: A despairing group of Christians and non-believer's band together during the biblical period, known as Tribulation, not only to survive death, but to escape America, and uncover a sinister globalist plot designed by an overreaching government.

programme.title: The Locator
programme.desc: Government-trained assassin Braxton is The Locator! Hand-picked for a special taskforce, his objective is to remove any threats to the safety and stability of the United States. With blood on his hands after completing the order to eliminate his partner, Braxton loses his lust for killing. When the governments best hit man walks off the job, the order is given to bring Braxton back or take him down.

programme.title: Sweet Justice
programme.desc: Four women run a private child support clinic by day but are collectors at night. Seeking out deadbeat parents and using seduction and force to make them pay up.

programme.title: Krooked Lines
programme.desc: It's a race against time in this fast moving suspense drama where the lines between cops, criminals, love, and loyalty intersect. Two friends, one motivated by the law, the other motivated by money, try to bring down a human trafficking ring, while dealing with the death of a lover, and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

programme.title: A Chosen Hope
programme.desc: After escaping her abusive husband, Talia has forged a new life for her and her daughter, Hope. When Hope begins experiencing mental illness and troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as "The Chosen Soul". Talia must race against time to save her daughter before it's too late.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.
